newsitem.title: USA: Carolco files new reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: Carolco files new reorganization plan.

text.p: Carolco Pictures Inc CRCP.OB said on Tuesday it filed a new joint plan of reorganization, replacing a plan filed in September.
The new plan provides a liquidating trust to sell Carolco's remaining assets, prosecute claims and make distributions to creditors.
Under the plan, all common stock and preferred stock will be cancelled and holders of the securities will not be entitled to receive distributions.
The plan also calls for certain of Carolco's subsidiaries that did not file for bankruptcy protection to be consolidated with the current debtors.
A hearing to approve the disclosure statement has been set for January 8, 1997. Creditors and other interested parties have until 11 court days prior to that date to object.

Carolco filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy petitions in November 1995 and subsequently sold many of their major assets including a $58 million deal to sell its film library to French pay television company Canal Plus for $58 million.
Prior to the plan's effectiveness, Carolco said it will continue to sell assets, including motion picture projects and sequel rights, in accordance with Bankruptcy Court procedures.
